posts.preview: Today, I had the honour of delivering the Ministerial Statement on behalf of the Honourable Modestus Amutse, Minister of Industry, Mines and Energy, at the Mineworkers Union of Namibia Southern Regional Roundtable here in Oranjemund, //Kharas Region

The minerals beneath our soil belong to all Namibians, but the dignity of the work belongs to you. It belongs to the miner working 800 metres underground in Rosh Pinah. It belongs to the operator working here in Oranjemund
And it belongs to the young person in this region, who is still waiting for an opportunity to build a better future
